id: cuad:Zounds Hearing, Inc. - MANUFACTURING DESIGN MARKETING AGREEMENT

findings.quoted_text: If the Manufacturer terminates this Agreement or cancels any purchase order without cause pursuant to Section 8.2, Subcontractor will stop all shipments and retain all inventory.
The first installment will be due thirty (30) days following the Effective Date and the second installment will be due sixty (60) days following the Effective Date.
If the Manufacturer terminates this Agreement or cancels any purchase order without cause pursuant to Section 8.2, Subcontractor will stop all shipments and retain all inventory.
findings.explanation: Only the Client has the right to terminate the agreement without cause, while your termination rights are restricted to breach or insolvency, though cancellation charges and incurred costs are paid.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other party.

findings.quoted_text: The first installment will be due thirty (30) days following the Effective Date and the second installment will be due sixty (60) days following the Effective Date.
findings.explanation: Payment of the second installment is deferred for 60 days, which exceeds the standard 30-day term and creates a cash flow delay for you.
findings.suggested_change: The first installment will be due thirty (30) days following the Effective Date and the second installment will be due thirty (30) days following the first installment.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed the terms and would like to request a small adjustment before signing: - Regarding the payment terms in the relevant clause, deferring the second installment for sixty days creates a cash flow delay, so I propose modifying it so that the second installment is due thirty days following the first installment. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
